_about: TEMPLATE for YOUR held-out set. Copy to eval/heldout_moments.json (gitignored), replace the placeholders with moments you choose yourself, then run: python scripts/validate_moments.py eval/heldout_moments.json --show <folder>. Choose moments BEFORE looking at the tool's output for those episodes. Every evaluation on this file is logged in eval/heldout_ledger.log.

moments.what: describe the moment in a few words
